title: The Burnt Letter
scene: At 10:25 AM, a letter was burned in the post office. The sorting room was sealed for an audit from 10:00 to 10:45.

suspects.name: Jonas Reed
suspects.testimony: I was in the sorting room at 10:25, checking the audit.
suspects.contradiction: The sorting room was sealed from outside, and ash marked Jonas's cuffs.

suspects.name: Kira Vale
suspects.testimony: I was at the counter at 10:25.
suspects.alibiProof: The counter camera shows Kira at 10:23 and 10:29.

suspects.name: Leo Pike
suspects.testimony: I was loading the mail van at 10:25.
suspects.alibiProof: The van log shows Leo's scan at 10:24.

suspects.name: Mina Ash
suspects.testimony: I was in the office at 10:25, reviewing books.
suspects.alibiProof: The office camera shows Mina at 10:20 and 10:31.
